column4: F: So what do the testers follow? | M: The U.A.T. Guide. Each step says what to do, and what to confirm on screen, with a box to tick. One button saves it as a P.D.F.

column4: F: And what is inside? | M: The client's own drawings. The floor plan. The beam and foundation layouts. All nine sheets, arranged in place. And the shed, built in 3D.

column4: M: Chapter B uses your own Shed drawings. First the floor plan on its own, labelled, so the tester knows it is their building.

column3: M: Do. Confirm. Then tick, by hand.
